title: Canonical maps for strict refinements
statement: Let C be a category, J and I preorders, V:J→Cᵒᵖ and U:I→Cᵒᵖ diagrams, e:J↪oI an order embedding, and h:V=e⋙U. For a presheaf P with the indicated colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], define the refinement map colim(V⋙P)→colim(U⋙P) by the colimit map of h followed by colimit.pre along e. On partial orders J and I it is the unchanged earlier map pointSystemRefinementMap, by definition. This map carries a representative at j to its transported representative at e(j), is compatible with composition of refinements, and commutes with natural transformations P→Q.

source.place: Tag 00YP, proof of lemma-refine-all-at-once; strict refinements preceding Tag 00YO

proof.text: Use the natural transformation induced by h and the associator to identify V⋙P with e⋙(U⋙P), then apply the colimit cocone of U⋙P. The colimit universal property proves the representative formula, composition, and naturality.
